#!/bin/sh
source $HOME/.bash_profile;

cd $AC_SYSTEM/interfaces/RAPT/scripts

GATEWAY="/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/Raptor/in"
DATE=`date +%Y-%m-%d`
TIME="16:00:00"
HOST="etrading.uk.mizuho-sc.com"
PORT="443"

function getRaptorFile
{
  CONFIG_ID=$1
  FILENAME="spotAdjustments_${DATE//-/}${TIME//:/}_${CONFIG_ID}.xml" ;

  if [ ! $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
    $DATE = $BusinessDate;
  fi

  echo $FILENAME ;
  ./getRaptorRestConvexityData.pl ../config/RaptorSnapConvexityConfig.xml $CONFIG_ID -d $DATE -t $TIME -h $HOST -p $PORT -o XML > $GATEWAY/$FILENAME
}

if [ $Live -eq 1 ]
then
  getRaptorFile EUR-LIVE
  getRaptorFile USD-LIVE
  getRaptorFile GBP-LIVE
  getRaptorFile GBPSONIA-LIVE
else
  getRaptorFile EUR
  getRaptorFile USD
  getRaptorFile GBP
  getRaptorFile GBPSONIA
fi
